senses.gloss:
भौम mfn. (-मः-मी-मं) Earthly, terrestrial, produced in or relating to
the earth.
 m. (-मः)
 1. The planet MARS.
 2. Hell.
 3. Ambergris.
4. Water.
 5. Life.
 f. (-मी) A name of ŚITĀ.
 E. भूमि the earth, and
अण् aff.
भौम (व) न m. (-नः) An epithet of Vishwakarman, the architect of gods.

भौमरत्न n. (-त्नं) Coral.
 E. भौम and रत्न a gem.

भौमिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Earthly, terrestrial.
 E. भूमि and ठक् aff.
